allow: Bash(cmd.exe /c "for /f ""tokens=5"" %a in \(''netstat -aon ^| findstr :4000 ^| findstr LISTENING''\) do taskkill /PID %a /F")
Bash(cmd.exe /c "powershell -Command ""Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object State, OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize""")

Bash(cmd.exe /c "powershell -Command ""$listener = [System.Net.Sockets.TcpListener]::new\([System.Net.IPAddress]::Any, 4000\); try { $listener.Start\(\); Write-Output ''Port 4000 is FREE''; $listener.Stop\(\) } catch { Write-Output ""Port 4000 is BUSY: $_" }""")

Bash(powershell -Command "$listener = [System.Net.Sockets.TcpListener]::new\([System.Net.IPAddress]::Any, 4000\); try { $listener.Start\(\); Write-Output ''Port 4000 is FREE''; $listener.Stop\(\) } catch { Write-Output ""Port 4000 is BUSY: $_" }")
Bash(powershell -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection | Where-Object {$_LocalPort -eq 4000} | Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, State, OwningProcess | Format-Table -AutoSize")
Bash(cmd /c "wmic process where ProcessId=36540 get ProcessId,Name,CommandLine 2>&1")
Bash(cmd /c "powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command ""Get-Process -Name node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,Name,Path | Format-Table -AutoSize""")
